title: : BE FILLED WITH JOY!
body: : BE FILLED WITH JOY! “Not in the passion of lust, even as the Gentiles who know not God” (ASV) 1 Thes 4:5 Some times, you see people who do those things which are not convenient and then you wonder why. It is because they are already lost to self and satan. How could a man of 55 or 65 be sleeping with a child who is 5 or 6 years old? Or still, how could a man sleep with an animal? What about cases of young men and women who are given to smoking of all kinds even when their health is failing them? “Therefore God gave them up in the lusts of their [own] hearts to sexual impurity, to the dishonoring of their bodies. For this reason God gave them over and abandoned them to vile affections.” (AMP) Rom 1:24-28. Keep to the Word in spite of what goes on in the world. God desires that your passion becomes Spiritcontrolled, Spirit-regulated, Spirit-coordinated as well as Spirit-restricted. Your actions, reactions and inaction should be guided by the Spirit, Eph 4:17.
prayer: Father, that I might be filled with Your Spirit thereby becoming Spirit-controlled, Spiritregulated, Spirit-coordinated and Spirit-restricted in all areas of my life in Jesus’ name, Amen.

title: : SPIRIT CONTROLLED P ASSION
body: : SPIRIT CONTROLLED P ASSION “Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, hath turned my wrath away from the children of Israel, while he was zealous for my sake among them, that I consumed not the children of Israel.” (KJV) Num 25:11 The wrath of God wouldn’t have been averted if not for that zealous, passionate young man whose name is Phinehas Eleazar. This young man rose to prominence and was listed among those who did exploits because of his righteous response to God’s cause. God rewarded Phinehas for his cleansing of the tabernacle by extending to him a covenant of peace that promised a lasting priesthood to his progeny, Num 25:12. If any must rise to prominence, the need to put on the cloak of passion can never ever be overestimated. Passion is that drive that gives wings to the vision to soar. Whosoever you are, passion keeps you on course. It’s passion that makes you rise early enough to get at work. Passions energizes your spirit to be doggedly committed. Reject the spirit of lethargy and nonchallant attitude, Rom 12:11-13.
confession: Dullness of spirit is not mine. I am vibrant and zealous. I am full of vivacity and joy.

title: : WITHOUT PASSION, VISION IS WINGLESS
body: : WITHOUT PASSION, VISION IS WINGLESS “. And unto one he gave five talents, to another two, and to another one; to every man according to his several ability.” (KJV) Whosoever you’re, you can be on fire. This life is a stage of performance where everyone is endowed with gifts to bring glory to God, Matt 25:14-15. Set yourself on fire and see the whole wide world gather to watch your wonders. Don’t bury your talent - be a Kingdom populator and hell depopulator - be sold out to the spread of the gospel. Spend one or two days to wait on God - get a clear-cut direction on what God will want you do with your life. You must affect several destinies. “O for a passionate passion for souls, O for a pity that yearns! O for the love that love unto death, O for a fire that burns! O for the pure prayerpower that prevails, That N / pours itself out for the lost! Victorious prayer in the Conqueror's Name, O for a PENTECOST!” Amy Wilson Carmichael.
prayer: O that the blazing fire might begin to glow in me. Burn up the dross of base desire. Make me a man with a big heart for You. Breathe on me, breath of God. Fill me up till I am wholly Thine and until this earthly part of me glows with Thy fire divine, for this I ask in Jesus precious name, Amen.

title: : YOU CAN BE ABLAZE FOR GOD!
verse: “He said to them, "Go everywhere in the world. Tell
body: : YOU CAN BE ABLAZE FOR GOD! “He said to them, "Go everywhere in the world. Tell the Good News to everyone” (ERV) Mark 16:15 No one can stand on the fence - you’re either a world-class Christian or a local-champion. A localchampion is self-centred, self-seeking and selfabsorbed. A world-class Christian is otherscentred, others-seeking and others-absorbed. He’s fulfilled in the fulfilment of others. How we must pray the Psalmist-kind of prayer, “Send us around the world with the news of your saving power and your eternal plan for all mankind” (TLB) Ps 67:2. Every opportunity to travel is an opportunity to spread the gospel of Christ and His eternal plan to all mankind. Pre-plan each trip with the mind of spreading the Word. World-class Christians, by God’s standard, are the only living being on earth. They make things happen for God and others. They wake up each morning with a fresh thought of making impact. To succeed as a world-class Christian, think less of self and think more of others, Col 3:23-24. In all eternal reward awaits us - nothing goes unrewarded, 1 Cor 3:8.
prayer: Lord Jesus, I am set for an admirable life - living daily as a world-class Christian affecting all positively within my circle of influence, Amen.

title: : BE A WORLD-CLASS CHRISTIAN
body: : BE A WORLD-CLASS CHRISTIAN “. I am fearfully. made.” (KJV) Ps 139:14 You’re no second class being - God designed you with no duplicate - you’re the only you. It’s the business of the devil to tell you words like: you’re not beautiful, you can never make it, you can’t get somebody to marry you, you’re too short/tall and the like. These are biggest lies from the pit of hell. None of these words agree with the Word of God and His big picture for you. When someone tells you - you’re ugly, you don’t have to react to such baseless, untrue words. Just give a bright smile. The fact that you are not yet there does not mean you will not get there. You are just on the go to reach the goal. It doesn’t matter who told you - you can never get somebody to marry you. His word is no final. God’s Word is, Isa 62:4. You’re never too short/tall. You are only of moderate height. Desist from every thought of inferiority. You’re a superior being for exceptional achievements. Never again undersell yourself to yourself. You are of great price!
confession: My faith is fired. My heart is lifted up. I will not in any way undersell myself to myself and others. I am the best among the best. I am great and reaching forth for great goals. Hallelujah!

title: : NEVER UNDERSELL YOURSELF TO YOURSELF
body: : NEVER UNDERSELL YOURSELF TO YOURSELF

title: : CRA VING FOR A DOUBLE POR TION ANOINTING
verse: and you know all things” (NKJV) 1 John 2:20.
body: : CRA VING FOR A DOUBLE POR TION ANOINTING PRA YER“But you have an anointing from the Holy One, and you know all things” (NKJV) 1 John 2:20. Anointing announces. That’s what you need to be distinct, distinguished and stand out. Anointing makes your life, business, ministry, writings, singing and praying produce result sweatlessly. Where other wouldn't know what to do, anointing makes you to know what to do and how to do what to do, thereby making your life a center of attraction. Compare our text with vs 27, “But the anointing which ye have received of him abideth in you. the same anointing teacheth you of all things, and is truth, and is no lie, and even as it hath taught you, ye shall abide in him” (KJV). You can be anointed afresh, Lk 11:13. Lewis Drummond said, “An awakening is ready to burst on the dismal scene when Christians have a deep, profound Spirit of prayer for an awakening.” With an overwhelming spirit of prayer you’re guaranteed an overwhelming spirit of God. Tarry until you’re endued with power.
prayer: Father, I need more - more of Your anointing, more of Your unction, more of Your power - to function per time in the realm of the supernatural in the name of Jesus, Amen.

title: : GOD W ANTS TO USE YOU
body: : GOD W ANTS TO USE YOU “And I will give you a new heart, and I will put a new spirit within you.” (DT) Ezek 36:26 How beautiful to sing, “Lord, prepare me to be a sanctuary, pure and holy, tried and true, with thanksgiving, I'll be a living, Sanctuary for You.” Everyone is useful to God. God never made a useless part of the body. As small as eyelids and nails are, they are important. So, the world cannot do without you - you’re of high esteem. God has a good plan for your life even right from the foundation of the world. Allow Him to execute His plans for your life. Let Him use you as He wants according to the original master plan. But then, He must work in you to work through you. As you cooperate with Him, He uses you to accomplish His purposes here on earth. And He keeps and protects you so as to produce more fruits. “Every branch in me that beareth not fruit he taketh away: and every branch that beareth fruit, he purgeth it, that it may bring forth more fruit” (KJV) John 15:2. When YOU give it all, you gain it all.
confession: My life-time, I will give God my lifetime. When I give God my life-time, He will take care of me. He will never ever let me die, I will give God my life-time.

title: : HIS EVER ABIDING PRESENCE
body: : HIS EVER ABIDING PRESENCE “You shall tread upon the lion and the cobra, The young lion and the serpent you shall trample underfoot” (NKJV) Ps 91:13 Nothing - absolutely nothing - can be compared with God's ever abiding presence. “And the LORD went before them by day in a pillar of a cloud, to lead them the way; and by night in a pillar of fire, to give them light; to go by day and night: He took not away the pillar of the cloud by day, nor the pillar of fire by night, from before the people” (KJV) Exo 13:21-22. The pillar with which they were led by day and night was a visible token of His divine presence. Angels are all around you to protect and run errand for you. “For he shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways.” (KJV) Ps 91: 11-12. “When they went from one nation to another, From one kingdom to another people, He permitted no one to do them wrong; Yes, He rebuked kings for their sakes, Saying, "Do not touch My anointed ones, And do My prophets no harm."” (NKJV) Ps 105:13-15.
confession: My God shall deliver me from the snare of the fowler and from the perilous pestilence. He shall cover me with His feathers, and under His wings shall I take refuge [Repeat it].

title: : SOARING ABOVE ADVERSITY
body: : SOARING ABOVE ADVERSITY “If thou faint in the day of adversity, thy strength is small” (KJV) Pro 24:10 You’ve got to promise yourself: I won’t fail in the days of adversity neither will my strength fail me. No matter the trouble around, never allow your faith to fail nor falter. Build up your faith to soar on eagle's wings. Refuse - regardless of - crisis within and around to be faint-hearted and feebleminded. You're made to soar above every situation. You can soar far above situation, sickness, lack, demonic attack and all evil vices. In sickness and affliction, you can declare, “Surely He has borne our griefs And carried our sorrows; Yet we esteemed Him stricken, Smitten by God, and afflicted. But He was wounded for our transgressions, He was bruised for our iniquities; The chastisement for our peace was upon Him, And by His stripes we are healed” (NKJV) Isa 53:45. In time of lack, “And my God shall supply all your need according to His riches in glory by Christ Jesus” (NKJV) Phil 4:19. Read Isa 54:17.
confession: By His limitless power, I go ahead to soar above every wind of adversity. I refuse - regardless of - crisis within and around to be fainthearted and feeble-minded.

title: 1: MAKING A BIG DIFFERENCE IN YOUR CORNER
verse: planned in advance for us to live our lives doing”
body: 1: MAKING A BIG DIFFERENCE IN YOUR CORNER “. God made us to do good works, which God planned in advance for us to live our lives doing” (NCV) Eph 2:10 TLB put our text thus, “It is God himself who has made us what we are and given us new lives from Christ Jesus; and long ages ago he planned that we should spend these lives in helping others.” He planned you and I to spend our lives helping - assisting and lifting others. TBCL says, “No, we neither make nor save ourselves. God does both the making and saving. He creates each of us by Christ Jesus to join him in the work he does, the good work he has gotten ready for us to do, work we had better be doing.” The Amplified says, “For we are God's [own] handiwork (His workmanship), recreated in Christ Jesus, [born anew] that we may do those good works which God predestined (planned beforehand) for us [taking paths which He prepared ahead of time], that we should walk in them [living the good life which He prearranged and made ready for us to live].” Because we are His, we can't but carry out His will, Jude 20-21.
prayer: I am set in my spirit for daily impact and positive Influence. I commit myself to God's cause - no one will pass my way without definite impact.

title: : P ASSION FOR EXCELLENCE
body: : P ASSION FOR EXCELLENCE “Whatever turns up, grab it and do it. And heartily! This is your last and only chance at it, For there's neither work to do nor thoughts to think In the company of the dead.” (TBCL) Eccl 9:10 You can exceed excellence. You can be a shining light. “But the path of the just is as the shining light, that shineth more and more unto the perfect day” (KJV) Pro 4:18. Are you saying, you're an excellence-driven person? Yes, it could be better - you could go from one level of excellence to another. Martin Luther King Jr said, “If a man is called to be a street sweeper, he should sweep streets even as a Michaelangelo painted, or Beethoven composed music or Shakespeare wrote poetry. He should sweep streets so well that all the hosts of heaven and earth will pause to say, Here lived a great street sweeper who did his job well.” God’s character goes with excellence. Every thing He created was v-e-r-y good. Gen 1:31, Strive to excel in all you do. The sky is no longer the limit - now the starting point. Go lead the way! Go blaze the trail!
confession: I live a life of approved excellence in all I do. Whatever my hands find to do, I do it with all my strength and might.

title: : P ASSION FOR END-TIME REVIV AL
body: : P ASSION FOR END-TIME REVIV AL “. O LORD, revive thy work in the midst of the years.” (KJV) Hab 3:2 “Revival”, said Charles G. Finney “is a renewed conviction of sin and repentance, followed by an intense desire to live in obedience to God. It is giving up one's will to God In deep humility.” David Smithers said, “We need a Heaven-sent revival, a burning fire from on high. We need a vision of eternity, of Hell and the Judgement Day, A fervent love for our Savior, that will gladly serve and obey. We need a Pentecostal purging and a breaking deep within, A vision of God Almighty and a river of tears for our nations sin.” God is ever ready to avert judgment. But He needs a man who will pay the price - who will give it whatever it takes, to get a hold of God and not let go. “. turn ye even to me with all your heart, and with fasting, and with weeping, and with mourning: And rend your heart, and not your garments, and turn unto the LORD your God: for he is gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness, and repenteth him of the evil” (KJV) Joel 2:12-13.
prayer: [With a fervent prayer] O LORD, revive thy work in the midst of the years, in the midst of the years make known; in wrath remember mercy.

title: : ABLAZE WITH P ASSION FOR SOULS
verse: me, if I preach not the gospel!” (KJV) 1 Cor 9:16
body: : ABLAZE WITH P ASSION FOR SOULS “. for necessity is laid upon me; yea, woe is unto me, if I preach not the gospel!” (KJV) 1 Cor 9:16 Soul-winning is God's deepest heart beat. He wants all men irrespective of race, culture and age to come to the saving knowledge of Christ. John Wesley rightly said, “You have nothing to do but save souls. Therefore spend and be spent in this work. it is not your business to preach so many times; but to save as many souls as you can. To bring as many sinners as you possibly can to repentance, and with all your power to build them up in that holiness.” C. H. Spurgeon says, “If sinners be dammed, at least let them leap to Hell over our bodies. If they will perish, let them perish with our arms about their knees. Let no one GO there UNWARNED and UNPRAYED for.” Let's re-visit the anointed message of General William Booth, “Your days at the most cannot be very long, so use them to the best of your ability for the glory of God and the benefit of your generation.” He further said, “Put your ear down to the Bible, and hear Him bid you go and pull sinners out of the fire of sin.” I leave you with Matt 28:19-20.
prayer: Set my spirit aflame for the spread of the gospel. May I be sold out to this noble task, Amen.

title: : DEVELOPING P ASSION FOR GIVING
verse: “He who gives to the poor will not lack.” (NKJV)
body: : DEVELOPING P ASSION FOR GIVING “He who gives to the poor will not lack.” (NKJV) Pro 28:27 One of the keys to kingdom prosperity is the kingdom mind frame for giving. Every harvest is tied to sowing. No one harvests without planting. If you must harvest more abundantly, you've got to sow more abundantly. “Blessed is he that considereth the poor: the LORD will deliver him in time of trouble” (KJV) Ps41:1. Giving commands blessings, brings about your financial fatness; commands your divine rise and supernatural turn around, Pro 11:25. Everyone has something to give - no matter how small - give what you have to get what God can give. Give to God, His projects and fellow humans. Cornelius was devoted to giving much alms [Acts 10:2, 4]. Onesiphorus was committed to refreshing God’s servant [2 Tim 1:1618]. The Temanites were committed to meeting needs [Isa 21:14]. You’ll reap if you faint not, read Gal 6:9.
confession: With this revelation, I commit myself to giving much alms, refreshing the ministers of God and committing myself to meeting needs. As I give, so will my life be blessed abundantly. I will never miss my reward as a giver.

title: : SER VICE AND SIGNIFICANCE
verse: the work you gave me to do” (NIV) John 17:4
body: : SER VICE AND SIGNIFICANCE “I have brought you glory on earth by completing the work you gave me to do” (NIV) John 17:4 Service and significance were God’s first intentions for your creation - to bring Him glory on earth by completing - your divine assignment. “And the LORD God took the man, and put him into the garden of Eden to dress it and to keep it” (KJV) Gen 2:15. Jesus did so much to save us. He gave us all He had - He gave His precious life - to bring us to the fold. Nothing like insignificant service - every service is great - some are visible while some are behind the scenes. There Is no connection between size and significance. It is not in the size, it's in the heart. To give an acceptable service, we must all see to it that it is done with a pure motive. The Bible says our work must be tried. “For other foundation can no man lay than that is laid, which is Jesus Christ. Every man's work shall be made manifest: for the day shall declare it, because it shall be revealed by fire; and the fire shall try every man's work of what sort it is.” (KJV)1 Cor 3:11-15.
confession: I offer myself as a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable to God, [which is] my spiritual service. I commit myself to bringing glory to God.

title: : ACCEPT YOUR UNIQUENESS
verse: that is given to us.” (NKJV) Rom 12:6
body: : ACCEPT YOUR UNIQUENESS “Having then gifts differing according to the grace that is given to us.” (NKJV) Rom 12:6 We are to complement and not to compete. We sometimes rarely realize our individual uniqueness and we tend more to compare and contest rather than complementing and completing what is lacking in others. “Having gifts (faculties, talents, qualities) that differ according to the grace given us, let us use them: [He whose gift is] prophecy, [let him prophesy] according to the proportion of his faith; [He whose gift is] practical service, let him give himself to serving; he who teaches, to his teaching.” (Amp) Rom 12:6-8. Your total package is of God. Nothing like right or wrong temperament - some are sanguine, some choleric, some melancholy while some are phlegmatic. If you study Bible characters, you’ll see that they were all differently endowed. Jeremiah was a melancholy. Peter was a sanguine. Paul was a choleric. Our uniqueness adds flavours to life. By the time you do what you can do best and I do what I can do best, we make our world a better place.
prayer: Lord, I receive the grace not to compare myself with anyone in Jesus’ name, Amen.

title: : THIRST FOR KNOWLEDGE
body: : THIRST FOR KNOWLEDGE “A wise man is strong, Yes, a man of knowledge increases strength” (NKJV) Pro 24:5 The earth, says the Bible, shall be full of knowledge. That we live in a world of knowledge is no news. The world has advanced - now a global village - information is now readily made available without leaving our houses. “. for the earth shall be full of the knowledge of the LORD, as the waters cover the sea” (KJV) Isa 11:9. So, seek knowledge. “Anyone who stops learning is old, whether at twenty or eighty. Anyone who keeps learning stays young. The greatest thing in life is to keep your mind young.” Knowledge increases your productivity and grants you strength for greater accomplishment. “. Yea, a man of knowledge increaseth might” (ASV) Pro 24:5. “The heart of the intelligent seeketh knowledge.” (YLT) Pro 15:14. Lack of knowledge limits, “My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge.” (KJV) Hos 4:6. With all your strength, seek knowledge for it is valuable than gold, Pro 8:10-11.
confession: Knowledge is the principal thing; therefore I will get knowledge: and with all my getting I will get understanding. I will exalt her, and she shall promote me.

title: : COVET THE BEST GIFTS
verse: unto you a more excellent way” (KJV) 1 Cor 12:31
body: : COVET THE BEST GIFTS “But covet earnestly the best gifts: and yet shew I unto you a more excellent way” (KJV) 1 Cor 12:31 God gives gifts for His gain and glory. “But the manifestation of the Spirit is given to every man to profit withal.” 1 Cor 12:8-10 says, “For to one is given by the Spirit the word of wisdom; to another the word of knowledge by the same Spirit; To another faith by the same Spirit; to another the gifts of healing by the same Spirit; To another the working of miracles; to another prophecy; to another discerning of spirits; to another divers kinds of tongues; to another the interpretation of tongues” (KJV). Here are reasons for spiritual gifts: 1. It helps perfect the saints 2. It helps the work of the ministry 3. It edifies the body. “For the perfecting of the saints, for the work of the ministry, for the edifying of the body of Christ: Till we all come in the unity of the faith, and of the knowledge of the Son of God, unto a perfect man, unto the measure of the stature of the fulness of Christ.” (KJV) Eph 4:12-14.
confession: Here comes my strong passionate desire - that I might be filled with all spiritual gifts In Christ Jesus. [Take time to pray fervently for those spiritual gifts you best desire from God].

title: : KEEP ON THE PURE AND PRAISEWOR THY PASSION
verse: praise, think on these things” (KJV) Phili 4:8
body: : KEEP ON THE PURE AND PRAISEWOR THY PASSION “Finally, brethren, whatsoever things are true, whatsoever things are honest, whatsoever things are just, whatsoever things are pure, whatsoever things are lovely, whatsoever things are of good report; if there be any virtue, and if there be any praise, think on these things” (KJV) Phili 4:8 A lecturer, Dr. Madison Sarratt, who taught mathematics at Vanderbilt University for many years. Before giving a test, the professor would speak to his class like this: “Today I am giving two examinations, one in trigonometry and the other in honesty. I hope you will pass them both. If you must fail one, fail trigonometry. There are many good people in the world who can't pass trig, but there are no good people in the world who cannot pass the examination of honesty.” Job held on to his righteousness. “My righteousness I hold fast, and will not let it go: my heart shall not reproach me so long as I live” (KJV) Job 27:6. Jacob did it right by returning the money he met in the sack, Gen 43:12. Treasurers at the temple were faithful, Neh 3:13.
confession: A pure, praiseworthy life shall be my daily practice. I won’t let God down neither will I disappoint Him.

title: : P ASSION FOR FELLOWSHIP
body: : P ASSION FOR FELLOWSHIP “And let us not neglect our meeting together, as some people do, but encourage one another, especially now that the day of his return is drawing near” (NLT) Heb 10:25 If you've got a personal encounter with Him and you truly know God as your heavenly Father, you'll always consider koinonia with Him as the highest opportunity here on earth. There was an account of a father who was to be away from home for about seven months. Shortly before his traveling, he took his family to a shopping center. Handing some money to his little girl, he said, “Lydia, take this money and buy anything you want.” The child’s eyes filled with tears as she held more tightly to his hand. “What's the matter, Honey?” he asked. “I don't want money, Daddy,” she said. “I want you!” That's exactly the way it should be with every child of God. Both personal and collective fellowship are of great importance. Enoch, Noah, Moses, Mary the sister of Martha, Paul and a host of others enjoyed sweet and enriching fellowship with the Father. Make fellowship with HIM a must.
confession: I’ll always maintain sweet and enriching fellowship with God the Father, the Son and the Holy Spirit more than ever before.

title: : P ASSION FOR GODLINESS
body: : P ASSION FOR GODLINESS “But thou, O man of God. follow after righteousness, godliness.” (KJV) 1 Tim 6:11 The words follow after are from Greek dioko meaning pursue or given to. We’re commanded to pursue and be given to righteousness and goodness. Considering some verses that follow, “. That thou keep this commandment without spot, unrebukeable, until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ: Charge them that are rich in this world, that they be not highminded, nor trust in uncertain riches, but in the living God, who giveth us richly all things to enjoy; That they do good, that they be rich in good works. Laying up in store for themselves a good foundation against the time to come, that they may lay hold on eternal life” (KJV) 1 Tim 6:14, 17-19. God loves to see godliness in our homes, Churches and the society at large. Love what God loves. Passionately pursue after godliness and be a standard wherever you're found, 1 Thes 5:23. Ask Him for entire sanctification. Pray that your entire being - spirit, soul and body - be blameless.
confession: Those things [mention them] having a grip over my life are losing their hold right now. I release myself to serve God better from now.

title: : P ASSION WITHOUT PRIDE
verse: arrogancy, and the evil way.” (KJV) Pro 8:13
body: : P ASSION WITHOUT PRIDE “The fear of the LORD is to hate evil: pride, and arrogancy, and the evil way.” (KJV) Pro 8:13 There is no pride in pride! There was a lady who won a highly sought after award whose praying mother smiled and said, “I was praying you would get it.” “Well, thank you,” she replied, “but I earned this by my own hard work.” How forgetful of the Word she was, “Not that we are sufficient of ourselves to think any thing as of ourselves; but our sufficiency is of God” (KJV) 2 Cor 3:5. Some depend on their abilities that they reject the fact that they owe God a word of admiration for every good thing. A man could boldly and proudly acclaim all achievement to himself if he were able to say, I brought myself into this world, control my present and future. Beware of pride! Ahithophel’s pride destroyed him, 2 Sam 17:23, Pro 29:23. Naaman’s pride almost hindered his miracle, 2 Kings 5:10-14. Haman’s pride earned him premature death, Est 3:5, 5:11, 6:6, 7:10. Nebuchadnezzar’s pride turned him an animal, Dan 4:30-34;5:20. How true! Pro 16:18.
confession: I come against every root of pride and I reject its expression in words, attitude and disposition [Confess this repeatedly].

title: : HIS PURPOSE SHALL PREV AIL
body: : HIS PURPOSE SHALL PREV AIL “Many are the plans in a man's heart, but it is the Lord's purpose that prevails” (NIV) Pro 19:21 I’ve come to decree and declare as a Godordained prophet: only God's purpose shall prevail over your life. I thwart and bring to nothingness every plan that is not of God going on in the realm of the spirit against your life and I send the fire of the Holy Ghost, to over take them now in the mighty name of Jesus. “In righteousness shalt thou be established [you'll never labour in vain]. “. thou shalt be far from oppression; for thou shalt not fear: and from terror; for it shall not come near thee. Behold, they shall surely gather together, but not by me: whosoever shall gather together against thee shall fall for thy sake. No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper; and every tongue that shall rise against thee in judgment thou shalt condemn. This is the heritage of the servants of the LORD. saith the LORD” (KJV) Isa 54:14-15, 17. “. I will strengthen thee; yea, I will help thee; yea, I will uphold thee.” Is 41:10-11, 13.
confession: The above prophetic decrees and declarations come to a reality in my life speedily. So, I enter into the realms of limitless possibilities. [Pray as led by God and believe the same].

title: : P ASSION AND POSSIBILITIES
body: : P ASSION AND POSSIBILITIES “And blessed is she that believed: for there shall be a performance of those things which were told her from the Lord” (KJV) Luke 1:45 “Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying, Jeremiah, what seest thou? And I said, I see a rod of an almond tree. Then said the LORD unto me, Thou hast well seen: for I will hasten my word to perform it” (KJV) Jer 1:11-12. The performance of God's Word depends solely on the confession of your mouth. Your mouth matters if you must matter. What you say is what He confirms. If you want to enjoy untold possibilities in all areas of life then learn to speak words of possibilities even when it is crystal clear that impossibilities are right before you. God needs your words of faith to turn things around for you. Just as faith formed the world so, faith forms the foundation on which your future is built. Faith brings a man to the world of possibilities. “But without faith it is impossible to please and be satisfactory to Him. Heb 11:6. Stop being moved by sight, start being move by the Word.
prayer: Dear Father, I ask that you help me key in into the life of faith for great possibilities in the precious name of Jesus, Amen.

title: : FLEE LUSTFUL PASSION
verse: fulfil the lust of the flesh” (KJV) Gal 5:16
body: : FLEE LUSTFUL PASSION “This I say then, Walk in the Spirit, and ye shall not fulfil the lust of the flesh” (KJV) Gal 5:16 Walking in the Spirit is the key - no other key - to overcoming the lust of the flesh. The Amplified says, “But I say, walk and live [habitually] in the [Holy] Spirit [responsive to and controlled and guided by the Spirit]; then you will certainly not gratify the cravings and desires of the flesh (of human nature without God).” Habitual walking and living in the Holy Spirit places you above human nature of fleshly desire. Your obedience to divine instructions positions you far above the wrong and evil nature. Here is God’s command, “Don't be tempted by their beauty; don't be trapped by their flirting eyes” (GNT) Pro 6:25. “That you put off, concerning your former conduct, the old man which grows corrupt according to the deceitful lusts” (NKJV) Eph 4:22. “Beloved, I beseech you as sojourners and pilgrims, to abstain from fleshly lust, which war against the soul” (ASV) 1 Pet 2:11. Finally, read 2 Tim 2:22.
confession: Lustful desire and passion shall not have its rule and dominion over my life and thought. The Word of God shall daily reign in my heart and prevail greatly.

title: : MEN OF P ASSION 1
body: : MEN OF P ASSION 1 “Quenched the violence of fire. waxed valiant in fight.” (KJV) Heb 11:34 Whitefield was the greatest evangelist of his time. At 26, he spoke to larger crowds or saw more converts. He was an innovative awakener. Born on Dec 16, 1714. He looked for bigger worlds to conquer and found one in America. His last service in Boston (population at the time, 17, 000) drew more than 20, 000 people. Whitefield’s services made news everywhere he went. Whitefield brought biblical characters and themes alive. The most acclaimed actor of the time, David Garrick, said, I would pay two guineas to say 'Oh!' like Mr. Whitefield. As historian Harry Stout observed, Whitefield showed how religion could be popular. Whitefield adopted a print and preach strategy for extending the evangelical revival. The first edition of his Journals, an account of his life and ministry, was printed in 1740 when he was 25. In 1742, he launched Christian History, a monthly periodical to report the successes of his revivals and revival of others. You are not called to be George Whitefield but you’re called to make impact and leave eternal legacy behind you.
confession: I am determined to go extra miles.

title: : MEN OF P ASSION 2
body: : MEN OF P ASSION 2 “Quenched the violence of fire, escaped the edge of the sword.” (KJV) Heb 11:34 William Wilberforce (1759-1833) was an English politician who became the voice of the abolition movement in Parliament. At 21, Wilberforce was elected to Parliament. After his conversion, he gave up gambling and attendance at clubs. That's true Christianity! He decided to serve God in public life. He championed many causes but it was the fight against the Slave Trade and Slavery that he worked most tirelessly for. In his late 30'S, Wilberforce married Barbara Spooner and remained devoted to her throughout his life. In early 1787, Thomas Clarkson called upon Wilberforce with a copy of his Essay on Slavery. This was the first time the two men had met, and a collaboration was formed which lasted over fifty years. The skills of the two men complemented each other. You always need others to succeed! You may not be able to do it all single-handedly, but you can make more impact with that man of like mindedness in that your office or political party, EccI 4:9. Go, succeed and go places!
prayer: Father, let Your Spirit keep working in me for extraordinary exploits in Jesus’ name, Amen.

title: : MEN OF P ASSION 3
body: : MEN OF P ASSION 3 “Quenched the violence of fire, escaped the edge of the sword.” (KJV) Heb 11:34 I have brought you a woman who gave it all to Jesus, Maria Woodworth-Etter by name. Maria was born on July 22, 1844. At 13 she was converted. Soon, she heard the voice of God tell her to “go to the highways and hedges and gather the lost sheep.” A few years later, she got married. Maria struggled with poor health and many times thought she would die. Within a few years, five of the six Etter's children had died leaving them in great grief and sorrow. But in all, she never gave up on God. She said, “In all these trials God was preparing me and opening the way for the great battle against the enemy of souls and now the great desire of my heart was to work for Jesus. I longed to win a star for the Savior's crown.” She finally started in her local area and saw many conversions. The power of God would fall and sinners would run to the front in repentance. Her meetings were with great power, healings and visions. Some of her meetings had over 25, 000 attendees. In 1912 she ministered in Dallas, for F. F. Bosworth and her ministry blossomed from there.
prayer: Use me to showcase Your glory, Amen.

title: : NO SHOR TCUTS TO THE TOP
verse: “There is a right time for everything” (ERV) Eccl 3:1
body: : NO SHOR TCUTS TO THE TOP “There is a right time for everything” (ERV) Eccl 3:1 Everything on earth takes time - nothing just happens suddenly – no magic to the top. Success in life, carrier, business or ministry takes time to succeed. Let’s follow divine route for our life and not just try to work things out in our own way. “He hath made every thing beautiful in his time: also he hath set the world in their heart, so that no man can find out the work that God maketh from the beginning to the end” (KJV) Eccl 3:11. He makes everything beautiful in His own time and not in our own time. While waiting for God's ordained time, keep appreciating God. Anything you don't appreciate depreciate. Make it a point of duty to thank Him in every thing and for every situation. Another important thing to be done is to keep serving Him. Deut 13:4, keep walking with God. Fear Him and keep to the standard of His Word. Don't forget to keep helping others. Help those who are down the ladder while you are trusting God for your next level. Be a lift. Let others rise through you, Pro 11:25.
prayer: Dear heavenly Father, I receive divine ability to keep serving You and helping others on my way to the top in Jesus precious name, Amen. “Do not, therefore, fling away your fearless confidence, for it carries a great and glorious compensation of reward!” (AMP) Heb 10:35 Whenever Lacedemonian women would present the shields to their sons going to battle, they were always saying: “Either bring this back, or be brought back upon it.” The child bringing back the shield is a proof that the child had preserved the shield to the last, and had been doggedly faithful to his country. They also used to deliver their fathers' shields, “This shield thy father always preserved; do thou preserve it also, or perish.” This was the command of the Lacedemonian mothers to their sons when going to battle. As we begin a brand new month, there comes the need to preserve your confident faith. By it you’ll quench every fiery dart of the wicked. Read verses 36-39 of our text. In spite of the challenges, do keep your confident faith alive. The LORD your God shall grant you a double portion of that you couldn’t get in the last six months. Quietly take into your spirit this prophetic pointer, Isa 61:7. It is your prophetic month of a double share of honour.
